recipe.visualDefinition: A warm, parchment-textured layout featuring a central horizontal band of varied rectangular photographic frames. The frames contain portraits of a male artist and close-ups of an acoustic guitar, anchored by a large, underlined serif title at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Grid of varying aspect ratios creating a rhythmic horizontal band
Warm tan background texture contrasting with the cool-toned studio photography
Thin orange borders unifying the disparate photographic elements
Strong horizontal alignment between the title underline and the top edge of the photo grid
coreInvariants: Single-line underline beneath the primary display text
Thin, high-contrast borders around every image frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is distributed across seven distinct frames in the lower two-thirds of the composition, while the text dominates the upper third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, centered serif title acts as the primary anchor, supported by the largest portrait frame on the left-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold title, moves down to the large portraits, and then scans horizontally across the smaller detail frames.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial negative space at the top and bottom, filled with a subtle, organic texture to prevent visual emptiness.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and cool blues (within the photography)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Burnt orange (frame borders and guitar wood tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low saturation background against high contrast, medium saturation photographic inserts.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended horizontal underline that spans the entire width of the text block
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with varying scale or underlining for emphasis.

preserve: Underline thickness matching the main stroke

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classical, high-contrast serif look of the era
Provides the sharp serifs and elegant vertical stress

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a warm, light tan background with a subtle mottled parchment or sponge-painted texture. In the center, arrange a horizontal band of seven rectangular photos of varying sizes. The photos should feature a male musician in 80s attire and close-ups of an acoustic guitar. Each photo must have a thin, sharp burnt-orange border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist's name in a large, all-caps, high-contrast serif font centered in the upper third. Include a solid black horizontal underline that runs exactly the length of the text.

verificationChecks: Is the background texture subtle and warm?
Are the photo borders thin and orange?
Is the text all-caps and underlined?

adjustableVariables: Specific color of the frame borders
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on all frames

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the underline does not touch the descenders of the letters
Verify the parchment texture is not overly distracting
Check that the orange borders are uniform in thickness
Confirm the all-caps serif font feels classical and formal
recipe.reuseFormula: Parchment Texture + Multi-Frame Grid + Underlined Serif Typography = 80s Sophisticated Portraiture Style
